name: Tsukushite Agechau 2 Nandemo Shichau no
original_name: 尽くしてあげちゃう2 なんでもしちゃうの
source:
Main character has rough appearance, but there are several girls around him who start to pay him a lot of attention. He wants just peaceful life with a girlfriend - but what will he get?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公外表粗犷，身边却有几名女孩开始格外关注他。他只想和女朋友过平静生活，但最终会得到什么？
